name: Chi Mamire Ryoujoku Maid
source:
A visual novel illustrating the assault and humiliation that unfolds as the new maid that comes to work at our protagonist's house is violated over and over.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ038533.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
一部视觉小说，讲述了来主角家里工作的新女佣一次又一次受到侵犯时所发生的攻击和羞辱。

[来自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ038533.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
